### The Evolution of Artificial Intelligence: From Theory to Reality

Artificial intelligence (AI) has come a long way since its conceptualization in the mid-20th century. Over time, AI has transformed from a niche academic pursuit into a cornerstone of modern technology, influencing nearly every aspect of human life. This journey has been marked by significant milestones, from early rule-based systems to today's sophisticated neural networks that can learn and adapt to complex tasks.

The roots of AI can be traced back to the 1950s when mathematicians and computer scientists began to explore the idea of creating machines capable of intelligent behavior.
